These three points form the universal principles for human poets to create Chinese classical poems. Chinese Classical poetry can be classiﬁed into two primary categories, SHI and CI. According to the statistical data from CCPC1.0, a Chinese Classical Poetry Corpus consist- ing of 834,902 poems in total (We believe it is almost a full collection of Chinese Classical poems). 92.87% poems in CCPC1.0 fall into the category of SHI and 7.13% fall into the category of CI.
